environment.description: Lambda deployed in isolated VPC (10.200.0.0/16) with no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no VPC peering connections. Function URL is disabled. Service is fronted by an internal NLB registered as a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer access requires explicit endpoint connection acceptance AND the endpoint policy restricts Principal to specific account IDs. The VPC has a route table with only local routes (10.200.0.0/16 → local) — no 0.0.0.0/0 route exists. Security group on the ENIs allows inbound TCP/3000 only from 10.200.0.0/16 CIDR. DNS resolution for the endpoint uses private hosted zone that is not associated with any external VPC.

vpc_config.subnets: private-only, no IGW, no NAT, no VPC peering

config.dns: private hosted zone, not shared externally
config.internet_access: none (no IGW, no NAT, no proxy)
